title.zh: 赌场管制（博彩机与博彩节目最高数量）命令 2026
title.en: Casino Control (Maximum Number of Gaming Machines and Gaming Programs) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Casino Control (Maximum Number of Gaming Machines and Gaming Programs) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 21 September 2026.

heading.en: Maximum number of gaming machines and gaming programs for casino

text.en:
2.—(1) The total number of gaming machines and gaming programs available for casino gambling must not exceed —
(a)for the casino operated by Marina Bay Sands Pte. Ltd. — 3,000; and
(b)for the casino operated by Resorts World at Sentosa Pte. Ltd. — 2,900.
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1) —
(a)each player terminal through which a bet may be placed on an electronic table game is considered one gaming machine; and
(b)each software application installed on an electronic device and through which a casino game may be played is considered one gaming program, even if the software application is capable of being used to play more than one type of casino game.
